mapper.sql: id, file_hash, file_name, file_ext, storage_path, file_size, mime_type, storage_type, ref_count, uploader_id, created_at
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM file WHERE file_hash = #{fileHash} LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM file WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file (file_hash, file_name, file_ext, storage_path, file_size, mime_type, storage_type, ref_count, uploader_id, created_at) VALUES (#{fileHash}, #{fileName}, #{fileExt}, #{storagePath}, #{fileSize}, #{mimeType}, #{storageType}, #{refCount}, #{uploaderId}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE file SET ref_count = ref_count - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND ref_count > 0
